question: Vinay starts from Point A and drives 3 km towards the North. He then takes a right turn, drives 2 km, then left and drives 3 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified).
solution:
Given:

Vinay starts from Point A and drives 3 km towards the North.

He then takes a right turn, drives 2 km, then left and drives 3 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fe910de56a0cf03e0cfd5b040e7e698069e8005a643550e07ada4863901db7f.png] 

He should drive 4 km to the East in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
